$comment: Example import mapping for a CASES21 ST export (e.g. ST_XXXX.csv). Only the columns listed here are read; every other column in the source file is ignored and never stored. See docs/research and proposal section 11.

source.$dateComment: CASES21 exports encode dates as Excel serial day numbers (e.g. 36526 = 2000-01-01).

STATUS.validate: active statuses promote; LEFT/LVNG mark inactive

BIRTHDATE.$comment: Data minimisation (proposal 11.1): the full birth date is used transiently during import to derive the competition age group (age as at the configured cut-off day of the competition year) and is NOT stored. Storing full DOB would require documented business need + policy approval.

GENDER.validate: one of M / F / X in source; maps to default competition category M / F / S
GENDER.$comment: Used to derive the student's default event-division category (M/F/S). Per-event and per-student overrides are authorised event-administration actions recorded with audit trail — the import value is a default, not a lock.

ageGroupRule.$comment: Age as at 31 December of the competition year, per School Sport Victoria convention. Confirmed by project owner 2026-07-24. MM-DD only: the year is not configured here - each roster import names its competition year (defaulting to the year of the next carnival), so this file needs no yearly edit. A legacy cutOffDate (YYYY-MM-DD) is still read for its month and day; its year is ignored.
ageGroupRule.$openBandComment: OPTIONAL senior band. Set openFromAge to collapse every student at or above that age into one band, and openLabel to name it (default 'SNR'). NOT set here: this school competes by plain age. 'OPEN' is REFUSED as openLabel - that token is reserved for an event scoped OPEN ACROSS the age axis (every age eligible), so a band of that name could never be scheduled as a division of its own (ADR-0014 Review notes 1). A purely numeric label is refused for the same class of reason: it would be indistinguishable from the plain age the derivation already produces. Example: "openFromAge": 17, "openLabel": "SNR".
